interpretation: “工作单一”结合该标注者同题delegation=0，推断其希望取消单个Coder的委派。候选把原Coder完整的频道扫描、月度筛选和演示写入全部移交主agent，保留其后的日历原生并行及最终邮件依赖。

changes.original: use one wave with exactly one Coder sub-agent.
changes.replacement: complete it directly in the main agent; do not dispatch sub-agents or add a source, writer or verification wave.
changes.explanation: 按单一工作且A=0推断无委派候选；不删除原子agent承担的任何必要工作。

changes.original: Use one Coder sub-agent to own one complete read-only Fireship channel catalog session and `Fireship_2025_Digest.pptx`.
changes.replacement: The main agent owns one complete read-only Fireship channel catalog session.
changes.explanation: 频道扫描由主agent执行，避免把仅本地工具office coder当成视频数据工具owner。演示仍由同一主agent单写。

changes.original: After Wave 1, the main agent validates all six selections, then issues six `list_events` calls natively in parallel
changes.replacement: After validating all six selections and the saved deck, the main agent issues six `list_events` calls natively in parallel
changes.explanation: 取消跨agent交接，保留六事件原生并行、准确slot与PPT就绪依赖。

changes.original: Only after deck and event inventory agree, check Sent mail and send one missing exact-recipient/subject email listing all six month/title/integer-view pairs.
changes.replacement: Only after deck and event inventory agree, check Sent mail and send one missing exact-recipient/subject email to team@company.com with subject Fireship 2025 Monthly Digest Ready.
changes.explanation: 保留最终邮件屏障及去重，补明原题给定的recipient/subject，无新增外部写入。

preserved_requirements: 完整Fireship频道list会话分页，2025年1—6月全部视频，各月计数与最高观看数，稳定ID tie-break，不虚构空月。
Fireship_2025_Digest.pptx恰7页，指定总标题和6个完整月份标题；月页含视频全名、整数views、分钟时长1位小数、当月视频数。
六个原题准确日期均09:00—09:30 America/New_York，Monthly Tech Digest Review - [Month Year]及视频标题描述。
list_events/create_event原生并行、只建缺失事件、逐ID get_event核对。
team@company.com与指定邮件主题，邮件覆盖1—6月标题和整数views；deck/event一致后才检查Sent并发送/读回。
assumptions: “工作单一”未逐项指定改法；无委派实现来自该人的B理由和同题A=0记录，仅是候选解释，不代表人工已确认具体实现。
plan_summary: 主agent接管全部视频分页、6月筛选与7页PPT创建。
主agent核对deck后并行检查/补建六事件并逐ID核对。
deck与事件一致后发送或复用唯一指定邮件并回读，主agent完成。
expected_tradeoff: 取消唯一子agent交接可能节省委派开销，但完整频道扫描进入主agent上下文可能增加负载；收益待实验验证。
